calibration_order: For each repetition and size, rotate and alternate all module/target pairs; retain every sample. No candidate-wise contiguous timing blocks.
forecast: Median fresh-proof plus execution outer-wall cost at the exact module/target/size, with the same mandatory proof in calibration and delivery. Completed observations replace only that exact cell; no small-input ratio is extrapolated to another size, target, or module. One-time construction is priced separately.
fixed_control: Complete finite budget-DP plan committed after identical initial baseline probes; reuse that target assignment throughout the episode.
dp_control: Complete multiple-choice DP over the same finite stationary remaining-suffix target assignments. Recompute after completed observations.
ndu_control: Unchanged native recursive utility and feasibility/Pareto evaluator over exactly those assignments; same initial bank, registered inputs, observation interface and build-attempt budget. Each executing arm sees its own completed observations, not another arm's future timings. Post-run audit gives complete DP the exact model passed to every NDU request. Registered plan-key tie resolution only within returned frontier.
resource_scope: One consumable compilation-attempt credit per episode shared across semantic modules, consumed before a candidate build and never refunded. Mandatory initial baseline builds and common calibration are charged wall costs outside this optimization-attempt quota. This is not a process memory or CPU-time bound.
activation_acceptance: At least one real NDU candidate build and correctly executed candidate output; semantic modules must have different Core hashes. Shared-budget competition additionally requires two individually predicted-profitable module options competing for the single credit, a feasible exact-DP-equivalent NDU selection, and one actual candidate build in that episode. None of these implies net benefit.
economic_acceptance: All outputs and attempt budgets admitted, and NDU complete cold standalone cost below both strong fixed and complete finite DP in every registered profile. No post-hoc acceptance change, sample exclusion or old result replacement.
cost_scope: Current common source/registration, driver and candidate builds, interleaved calibration, native identity admission, proposal/proof/compilation, fresh artifact checks, request construction, NDU session work, actual execution, evidence writes and shutdown. The exact empty-target outer native-build envelope is charged once to each NDU standalone deployment. Warm totals omit only that build. Residual dispatch/source recheck cost is conservatively charged to each native arm.
analysis_scope: Post-run selection-regret and activation analysis is reported separately and excluded from strategy wall totals; it receives no execution authority and changes no observations.
excluded_costs: acquisition of preexisting dependency source caches
post-run analysis and final aggregate encoding/archival
human engineering outside the registered driver
sample_exclusion: none; failed, refused and timed-out attempts retained with their incurred cost
measurement_scope: Three finite groups on the available nonexclusive Linux host. These are two small kernels, not a representative application or a verified dot-host result. No statistical or universal superiority claim.
